# Lab Catalog — AWS Certified Developer (DVA-C02) Hands-On Labs

Single source of truth for every planned lab: what it teaches, where it lives, and which exam skill IDs it covers. See `AGENT.md` for the rules every lab must follow and `labs/README.md` for the student-facing orientation.

**File path convention:** `labs/<module>/<task>/lab-<seq>-<slug>.md` — each table below is scoped to one task folder, so only the filename is shown.

**Status values:** `Planned` (catalog entry only, no file yet) → `Drafted` (file generated by `/build-lab`, not yet run) → `Reviewed` (a human has run it end-to-end in the playground and confirmed it fits the ~30 min / cleanup / limits requirements).

All labs below are **Planned** unless listed in the Drafted/Reviewed status log, which tracks status separately so the per-domain tables don't need a column edited on every generation run. Generate a lab's content with `/build-lab <Lab ID>`.

### Status log

| Lab ID | Status |
|---|---|
| D1-T1-L01 | Drafted |
| D1-T1-L02 | Drafted |
